newsitem.title: LATVIA: BOURSE TO DECIDE ON NEW LISTINGS WITHIN A WEEK.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE TO DECIDE ON NEW LISTINGS WITHIN A WEEK.

text.p: The Riga stock exchange said on Tuesday it plans to decide on listing the Liepaja Metal plant and Olainfarm in a week's time.

"Both companies have their share issues registered at the central depository and the bourse will in the nearest time, at the latest in a week, decide on their listing," Uldis Cerps, the bourse president, told Reuters.
The two companies are still in the process of submitting the mandatory documents, Cerps said.

Liepaja Metalurgs, the only metal producer in Latvia, has registered 8.49 million shares in the depository and Olainfarm, one of the biggest pharmaceutical firms in the country, has stock of 2.99 million shares.
Analysts expect both companies to be placed on the secondary list.
